key_factors: Unbeaten through UEFA World Cup qualifying — consistent, professional quality
Granit Xhaka fit and ready to orchestrate from deep; no injury concerns

reasoning: Switzerland are the heavy favourites and rightly so. Qatar's technical limitations in midfield will be exposed by Xhaka's control of tempo. Yakin's defensive organisation means Qatar's counter-attacking plan through Afif will be snuffed out early. Switzerland's set-piece delivery and attacking movement from the full-backs should create multiple chances. The only minor concern is the 1-1 draw vs Australia in warm-ups showing they don't always convert dominance — but against Qatar's level, two goals is firmly within reach. Switzerland should top Group B with three points from this opener.
